headline: FIN.K.L opens official SNS, unveils first group profile in 21 years
sub: Two-year music and concert project leading to their 30th anniversary

info.title: At a glance
rows: Lee Hyori, Ok Joo-hyun, Lee Jin, Sung Yu-ri

source: Source: Gemstone E&M, Star Daily News, My Daily
caption:
First-generation girl group FIN.K.L has opened official social media channels and revealed their first full-group profile photos in 21 years.

The photos show Lee Hyori, Ok Joo-hyun, Lee Jin and Sung Yu-ri in black dresses and classic suits against a monochrome backdrop. The group plans a roughly two-year project focused on music and concerts leading up to their 30th debut anniversary in 2028, with detailed schedules to be announced. Their handwritten notes read: "See you soon!" (Lee Hyori) and "Thank you for waiting" (Sung Yu-ri).

📌 Source: Gemstone E&M via Star Daily News, My Daily (via Korean media)
